question: Roshan Kumari, Shovana Narayan, Maya Rao and Kumudini Lakhia are eminent ______ artists.
solution:
The correct answer is **Kathak**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Roshan Kumari**, **Shovana Narayan**, **Maya Rao**, and **Kumudini Lakhia** are all celebrated figures in the Kathak dance form.
 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form originating from the northern parts of India, known for its intricate footwork and spins.
 
• These artists have contributed significantly to the **growth and popularity** of Kathak, both in India and internationally.
 
• They have been **awarded** and recognized for their mastery and dedication to the art form, inspiring generations of dancers.
